title_ar: الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو يؤم الناس في السودان
title_en: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Leads the People in Prayer in Sudan
body_ar:
أقام فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء خطبة الجمعة (15/6/1434هـ - الموافق 26-04-2013م ) في جامع " خاتم المرسلين" بالعاصمة السودانية الخرطوم.

الخطبة كانت منا سبة تحدث فيها الشيخ محمد الحسن باستفاضة عن واقع المسلمين اليوم وما يتعرضون له من إبادة جماعية وتصفية ممنهجة على يد أنظمة غربية لا ترقب في مؤمن إلا ولا ذمة وطوائف بدعية حانقة ولغت في دما ء وأعراض الموحدين واستباحت قتلهم على أساس الهوية .

وقدم الشيخ أمثلة مما يحصل في سوريا والعراق وبورما وغيرها حيث يتعرض العزل من النساء والأطفال والشيوخ لأبشع صنوف الإهانة والقهر والتنكيل، وتهدم المساجد والمدارس والمنازل على رؤوس المسلمين في ظل صمت مطبق من الدول الغربية و الدوائر الدولية والمنظمات الحقوقية ،في تواطئ سا فر مع السفاحين المجرمين.

كما قدم الشيخ محمد الحسن صورا مشرقة من عظمة الإسلام وقادته و أمرائه يوم كان للاسلام حكم وهيبة حيث نشروا العدل والرحمة بين الناس وكانوا يوصون بأن لا يتبع فار ولا يجهز على جريح ولا يتعرض لشيخ ولا امرأة ولا طفل ولا دار عبادة .

وختم الشيخ محمد الحسن بدعا ء مؤثر سأل الله فيه أن يرفع الظلم و القهر عن المسلمين وأن يبرم لهذه الأمة أمر رشد يعز فيه أهل طاعته ويذل فيه أهل معصيته ويقام فيه العدل الذي قامت به السماوات و الارض..
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered the Friday sermon (khuṭbah) (15/6/1434 AH — corresponding to 26-04-2013) at the 'Seal of the Messengers' congregational mosque in the Sudanese capital Khartoum.

The sermon was an occasion on which Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan spoke at length about the present condition of the Muslims and the mass extermination and systematic liquidation to which they are exposed at the hands of Western regimes that observe towards a believer neither tie of kinship nor covenant of protection, and of rancorous sects of innovation (bidʿah) that have lapped up the blood and the honour of those who profess God's oneness and have held the killing of them to be permissible on the basis of identity.

The Sheikh gave examples of what is happening in Syria, Iraq, Burma and elsewhere, where defenceless women, children and elderly people are exposed to the most hideous kinds of humiliation, subjugation and persecution, and mosques, schools and houses are demolished on the heads of the Muslims amid an absolute silence from the Western states, the international bodies and the human rights organisations — in flagrant collusion with the criminal butchers.

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan also presented luminous pictures of the greatness of Islam and of its leaders and princes in the days when Islam had rule and standing, when they spread justice and mercy among people and used to enjoin that no fleeing man be pursued, that no wounded man be finished off, and that no old man, no woman, no child and no house of worship be touched.

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan closed with a moving supplication in which he asked God to lift injustice and subjugation from the Muslims, and to settle for this community an affair of right guidance, in which the people of His obedience are honoured and the people of His disobedience are humbled, and in which is established the justice by which the heavens and the earth are upheld…

flags.arabic: وطوائف بدعية حانقة ولغت في دماء وأعراض الموحدين واستباحت قتلهم على أساس الهوية
flags.context: the reporter's summary of the sermon's account of who is killing Muslims
options: rancorous sects of innovation (bidʿah) that have lapped up the blood and the honour of those who profess God's oneness
embittered heretical factions that have waded in the blood and honour of the monotheists
aggrieved sectarian groups that have shed the blood and violated the honour of the Muslims
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. In a sermon of April 2013 naming Syria and Iraq, 'طوائف بدعية' is a sectarian designation of identifiable religious communities, and 'استباحت قتلهم على أساس الهوية' charges them with sectarian killing. Rendered faithfully — neither softened nor strengthened — but the English is materially more inflammatory than the Arabic reads to its original audience, and it is a reporter's summary rather than the Sheikh's transcribed words. Publication is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office. Note also that 'وَلَغَ' (to lap, as a dog laps) is a deliberately degrading verb, retained.

flags.arabic: لا ترقب في مؤمن إلا ولا ذمة
options: that observe towards a believer neither tie of kinship nor covenant of protection
that respect neither kinship nor treaty where a believer is concerned
flags.note: A direct echo of Sūrat al-Tawbah 9:10, { They observe towards a believer neither tie of kinship nor covenant of protection }. Since the Sheikh is speaking and not quoting, it is rendered as prose rather than inside the Qur'anic quotation marks, but the reference should be visible to the reader.

flags.arabic: منا سبة / دما ء / تواطئ سا فر / بدعا ء / سا مية
options: reproduce the broken spellings in the English
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11), corpus-wide. This record and several others in the 820–860 range carry spurious spaces inside words ('منا سبة' for 'مناسبة', 'دما ء' for 'دماء', 'سا فر' for 'سافر', 'بدعا ء' for 'بدعاء'), evidently from the CMS or from the original word-processor file. Preserved in body_ar, read through in body_en. This should be cleaned globally, not per record.

flags.arabic: أن يبرم لهذه الأمة أمر رشد يعز فيه أهل طاعته ويذل فيه أهل معصيته
options: to settle for this community an affair of right guidance
to ordain for this community a matter of right direction
flags.note: The supplication quotes the well-known farewell sermon of al-ʿIrbad ibn Sariyah ('يُبرم لهذه الأمة أمر رشد…'), with the added clauses about honouring and humbling. Rendered as prose within the report; the reporter gives no attribution and none has been added.

translator_notes: A news report about a sermon, not the sermon itself. Marked critical_for_display because the page carries a summarised polemic without the sermon's own framing or qualifications, and the reader has no way to check the paraphrase against the Sheikh's words. No legal ruling appears anywhere in the text; nothing here should be presented as a fatwā. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
